Name: Mail Society (Online Picture messenger and Trade no CO-OP)
Author: Cenooooon
Description:
🔥 [NEW UPDATE] NEXUS CHAT & MAIL – CONNECT, TRADE & SHARE ACROSS SERVERS! 🌐🌾
Hey everyone! If you are tired of the lonely grind in your single-player world, or want to interact with friends without the hassle of hosting a co-op save, this mod is a total game-changer.
I’ve put together a mod that links all Stardew Valley farmers together through an online server network.
✨ Key Features:
[list]
[*][b]📌 Global In-Game Chat (Social Network Style)[/b] Your game now features a fully integrated online chat system. Chat, joke around, or share farming tips with other players worldwide in real-time while you farm or fish. No more lonely single-player vibes![/*]
[*][b]📌 Cross-World Gifting & Item Trading[/b] This is the best part: you can send resources, crops, weapons, or gifts directly to another player—even if you aren't playing in the same save world! As long as the recipient is connected to the network, you can instantly ship items over across different servers.[/*]
[*][b]📌 [NEW] The MS Smartphone – Remote Access & Instant Sharing![/b] 📱 Pierre is now stocking a brand new item at his general store: the [b]SmartPhone MS[/b]! This handy device gives you full control of the network on the go:
[list]
[*][b]Left-Click:[/b] Instantly log into the [b]Mail Society[/b] system from anywhere, no matter where you are on the map.[/*]
[*][b]Right-Click:[/b] Snap a screenshot of your game and upload it directly to the Mail Society homepage! It’s the perfect way to flex your beautifully designed farm, your legendary catches, or your rare crop harvests.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]📌 No Co-op Required (Keep Your Own Progress)[/b] The mod runs completely independent of the game's default multiplayer mode. You can enjoy your own story, at your own pace, while still being part of a massive online community.[/*]
[/list]🛠 Requirements & Installation:
[list]
[*]Requires the latest version of SMAPI to run smoothly.[/*]
[*]An active internet connection is required while playing to sync the chat, online mailbox, and smartphone features.[/*]
[*][b]How to install:[/b] Just extract the file and drop the folder straight into your game's
[code]Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*][i]Note: Don't forget to visit Pierre's General Store to grab your SmartPhone MS![/i][/*]
[/list]Download it now to make Pelican Town a whole lot livelier! If you run into any bugs or have suggestions, drop a comment below and I'll look into it.
Happy farming, connecting, and sharing! 🥂👇
